params.T2_ladder: pattern_lib ladder_band in (0, 1) (below_q10, at_or_above_q10); REFUSED (-1) => FALSE (V1.1 D1)
params.T4_age_A: extreme_age_sec (phase H for SHORT / L for LONG) in [0, 200]
params.T4_age_B: pivot_age_sec (most recent causal ZigZag pivot of the faded type) in [0, 200]
params.T5_slope: sign(slope_1m_usd) == side and sign(accel_usd) == side, both non-zero
params.arm_P016: PATTERN_LEDGER P016 NY_SHORT_ROLLOVER_CONCORDANT: ext_needed <= $450 and phase_age >= 300s; runway >= 20000s with phase_close == sess_close; f60_n >= 5 and f60_vol >= 10; sign(fph_sflow) == side, fph_vol >= 200, |sflow|/vol >= 0.05; rv1800/rv60 < 8.0. P001's slope/accel term is DROPPED by name. Sub-clause thresholds taken verbatim from engine/port_m2/e1d1_policy.terms (T3/T5).
params.destruction: each term shuffled WITHIN SESSION, 40 replicates, RandomState(20260814 + term index); the other four terms untouched. The destroyed quantity is the EDGE (mean cert of the firing set minus mean cert of the non-firing rest, both readings), not the level — a level comparison is dominated by the population's negative mean

frame.causality: every window is searchsorted on the SANE second grid and bounded at dec_sec; ZigZag pivots kept only when conf_sec < dec_sec
frame.event_window: D10 — sflow over [release_sec, dec_sec) when a SCHEDULED release (BLS + FOMC calendars, context._bls_calendar / context._fomc_calendar) landed inside the running phase. The release is availability-lagged the same way S12's `last_scheduled` is: only events with event_ts STRICTLY < decision_ts are visible (CC-M2-1.2), and the calendar itself is SCHEDULE_EXEMPT under D-057 because the dates are published months ahead. The window NEVER spans the release second: it starts AT it.

fields.cert_close_usd: c_c_roster.certificates(...)[1][0] — the walled PHASE-CLOSE certificate (the CC-M1-8 adoption metric)
fields.cert_peak_usd: c_c_roster.certificates(...)[0][0] — the walled PEAK-EXIT companion (CC-M1-8 mandatory column)
fields.cert_refused: the walled certificate or the MAE could not be computed for this candidate.  R122: `NaN >= 1000` is False, so such a row used to be scored a MEASURED LOSER and counted in every winner-rate denominator.  `winner` is now False AND this flag is True, so a consumer can drop the row from BOTH halves of a rate instead of biasing it low.
fields.coverage_phase: sections.s3_path COVERAGE for the running phase = SANE range so far in the phase / (move_q50_usd_per_sigma * sigma_hat_usd) of that phase's fvol row; NaN when the fvol row carries no q50 (REFUSED, V1.1 D1)
fields.coverage_session: the same number on the SESSION clock/forecast
fields.day_type: S2 day_type_so_far as an ordinal: 0 INSIDE (<0.60), 1 AT_RANGE (<1.00), 2 EXPANDED (>=1.00); -1 = REFUSED
fields.day_type_frac: S2 range_so_far / range_hat — the '% of range_hat' the sheet prints; NaN when range_hat is REFUSED
fields.event_in_phase: the release landed INSIDE the running phase and before the decision: phase_seg_start <= release_sec < dec_sec
fields.ext_needed_usd: NEW range beyond the phase extreme the $1,000 bar still needs: max(0, 1000 - (entry_mid - phase_lo)*mult) for a SHORT, max(0, 1000 - (phase_hi - entry_mid)*mult) for a LONG (e1d1_policy T3 / P016 clause 1)
fields.extreme_age_sec: dec_sec - phase_hi_sec (SHORT) or - phase_lo_sec (LONG): the age of the phase extreme the trade fades
fields.f30m_n: S8 30m window trade count, sec in [dec-1800, dec)
fields.f5m_n: S8 5m window trade count, sec in [dec-300, dec)
fields.f60_n: S8 60s window trade COUNT, sec in [dec-60, dec)
fields.fev_n: EVENT-ANCHORED window (D10) trade count over [release_sec, dec); -1 = REFUSED (no release inside the phase)
fields.fev_sflow: event-anchored signed flow (buy_vol - sell_vol) — the flow accumulated SINCE the release, never across it; 0 with fev_n = -1 = REFUSED
fields.fph_n: S8 phase window trade count, sec in [phase_seg_start, dec)
fields.fph_sflow: S8 phase cumulative signed flow (buy_vol - sell_vol)
fields.ladder_band: sections.s9_vol ladder_position as an ordinal (see LADDER_BANDS); -1 = REFUSED (no move_q* in the fvol row)
fields.level_dist_atr: |nearest KEPT-family level price - entry_mid| / ATR, over levels alive at dec_sec (V1.1 birth guard) and within +/-1.5xATR; NaN when there is none
fields.mid_now: SANE mid at dec_sec (last SANE second <= dec_sec)
fields.phase_hi_sec: FIRST second at which phase_hi was reached
fields.phase_lo_sec: FIRST second at which phase_lo was reached
fields.phase_seg_end: one past the last second of that segment
fields.phase_seg_end_is_session_end: the running phase SEGMENT's end is the session's realised end (s.n), so any quantity divided by the segment length (runway_frac, retrieval axis B05) or defined over the whole segment (sched_release_in_phase) inherits an END-OF-SESSION fact on this row.  Declared, not silent.
fields.phase_seg_start: first second of the phase SEGMENT containing dec_sec
fields.pivot_age_sec: dec_sec - pivot_sec of the most recent CAUSAL ZigZag pivot of the faded type (HIGH for a SHORT, LOW for a LONG), conf_sec < dec_sec; -1 = none yet
fields.range_hat_usd: S2/S9 `range_hat_usd` of the DECISION PHASE's fvol row (both sections read case.fvol_seg); NaN = REFUSED
fields.range_so_far_usd: S2 range_so_far = SANE session range over [0, dec) in dollars (= range_sess_usd)
fields.release_age_sec: decision_ts - release_ts, the S12 `last_scheduled` age; -1 = no prior scheduled release
fields.release_sec: release_ts on the SESSION clock (release_ts - open_utc); -1 = none
fields.release_ts: epoch second of the most recent SCHEDULED release strictly BEFORE decision_ts (BLS + FOMC calendars, SCHEDULE_EXEMPT per D-057 — the dates are known months ahead); -1 = none
fields.session_close_exit: phase_close_sec == sess_close_sec — the S13 exit_default IS the session close
fields.slope_1m_usd: sections.s5_tminus mid_slope last-minute column = (mid(dec) - mid(dec-60)) * mult
fields.spread_ratio: spread_dec_usd / phase-median spread (c_a_cost, per asset x phase) of the STRICTLY PRIOR calendar year — the P005 'spread tax' state.  R119: the normaliser used to be the decision's OWN calendar-year pooled median, which includes the decision day and every day after it; that is a forward statistic on a reader-facing retrieval axis (B08).  NaN = REFUSED (no prior year on this asset's tape); see spread_ratio_basis_year.
fields.spread_ratio_basis_year: the calendar year whose pooled phase-median spread normalised spread_ratio (always the year BEFORE the decision); -1 = REFUSED
fields.surprise: S9 realized_range_so_far / range_hat, where the realized range is the PHASE segment's [seg_start, dec) SANE range (S9's own numerator, not S2's); NaN = REFUSED
fields.walled: the $-wall was hit on the adverse skeleton
fields.winner: cert_close >= $1000 and mae <= $300 and not walled (D-021)

frame.fix_pass_D001: R119 spread_ratio is normalised by the STRICTLY PRIOR calendar year (was: the decision's own year, a forward statistic on live retrieval axis B08); R120 phase_open_mid carries the have_ph guard so it can no longer emit a post-decision mid; R122 cert_refused makes an uncomputable certificate a REFUSAL rather than a measured loser, and the per-session cost fallback is counted (cost_fallback); R110 runway_binding_refused names the silent degeneration of reading B into reading A; the ATR broadcast refuses instead of propagating a sentinel.  These change the DEFINITION of committed fields, so PARAMS_FRAME moves and every consumer's params_hash moves with it — which is the point.

params.holdout: D-058 — the population comes from pattern_lib.sessions_fit, which EXCLUDES every session >= 20250701 and returns the excluded count for the receipt (R105). The GATE echo is a HALF year and is named GATE_2025H1 so no reader mistakes it for the whole year.
params.holm_families: R107 — THREE declared families, corrected separately and named on their own tables: (1) GEE, every robust row of EVERY arm (it used to be one family PER ARM, screening 48 tests as three families of 16, although arms A and B are two readings of the same T4 term and P016 is a third mutation of the same pattern); (2) MIRROR (P001_MIRROR.tsv); (3) PROMOTION (P001_PROMOTION.tsv)
params.in_sample: R114 — every threshold here was fitted on E1 study sessions inside FIT, so every table carries a FIT_EX_FITTING era dropping the 10 threshold-fitting sessions; the difference between FIT and FIT_EX_FITTING is the optimism. The support-set table is a REPRODUCTION CHECK, not evidence.
params.inference: CC-M1-12.4 — GEE independence working correlation with the Liang-Zeger sandwich clustered on SESSION (CR0 + Cameron-Miller CR1); Kish one-way ICC/DEFF for n_eff. R113: no GEE below 30 clusters, and the reference is t(G-1) not the standard normal.
params.mirror_law: R112 — the T5 direction claim is compared with its SIGN-FLIPPED twin WITHIN each session and decided by m2_common.mirror_paired (session-clustered paired t, t(n-1), NO_TEST below 30 sessions)
params.population: frozen v3 roster, FIT years [2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; 2025 = GATE echo, EVAL-ONLY
params.promotion: R106 — a promotion ratio carries a 2000-replicate SESSION-CLUSTERED bootstrap interval, a floor of 30 fires spanning 20 sessions, and Holm membership. seed 20260901.
params.refused_fvol_census: CC-M2-8.4 — per (asset, era) count/fraction of fvol rows with no move_q* quantiles and of candidates whose S9 ladder / S3 COVERAGE is therefore REFUSED
params.un_censused_constants: declared basis, one line each (3.2b MINORS). COVERAGE_MAX 0.70 / LADDER_BANDS_FIRE (0,1) / RUNWAY_MIN_SEC 26000 / AGE_MAX_SEC 200 are the PATTERN_LEDGER P001 `sheet_fields` literals, read off the E1 warm-up post-mortem and NOT swept; EXT_MAX_USD 450 / PHASE_MIN_AGE_SEC 300 / RUNWAY_MIN_SEC_P016 20000 / F60_MIN_N 5 / F60_MIN_VOL 10 / PHASE_MIN_VOL 200 / SFLOW_MIN_FRAC 0.05 / RV_RATIO_MAX 8.0 are taken VERBATIM from the committed executable form (e1d1_policy.terms T3/T5) and are pinned to it rather than re-fitted here; the destruction retention bands (0.80/0.50) are now GATED by a permutation p and an n floor rather than deciding alone (R106); alpha 0.05 is the program-wide Holm level. NONE carries a sensitivity sweep — the sweep is a build item, and saying so is the point of this entry.
params.value: c_c_roster.certificates — walled PHASE-CLOSE (adoption) and walled PEAK-EXIT (CC-M1-8 companion), both always reported
params.winner: cert_close >= $1000 and mae_before_argmax <= $300 and not walled (D-021)
